category: 國家童軍總部 (National Scout HQ)
name: 烏克蘭童軍全國組織總部
nameEn: National Organization of Scouts of Ukraine Headquarters
description: WOSM Europe 列 National Organization of Scouts of Ukraine（NOSU）為 Ukraine 的 WOSM 成員 NSO。European Youth Portal official organisation page lists NOSU address as Novo-Darnytska, 26, Kyiv, phone +380971707229 and website ukrscout.org. WOSM Europe lists +380979460875 as NOSU contact phone.

category: 官方社交頁聯絡點 (Official Social Contact Point)
name: Scouts of Ukraine Kyiv contact point
nameEn: Scouts of Ukraine contact point, Pochaynynska Kyiv
description: NOSU official Facebook page “Scouts of Ukraine” lists the page as the WOSM member in Ukraine, with address Почайнинська 48, Kyiv and email secretariat@ukrscout.org. This entry records that official social-contact address separately from the EU Youth Portal address.

category: 全國童軍小組網絡 (National Scout Groups Network)
name: NOSU 全國童軍小組網絡
address: Nationwide; contact via NOSU secretariat and local groups
description: NOSU official English website says Scouts of Ukraine has 35+ groups in Ukraine and welcomes members regardless of age, background, race, gender or religion. WOSM Peace Platform materials note NOSU work across all regions and regional offices in Ukraine.

category: 童軍營隊計劃 (Scout Camps Programme)
name: NOSU camps and nature events programme
nameEn: Scouts of Ukraine Camps and Nature Events Programme
address: Nationwide camps and events; contact via NOSU
description: NOSU official website lists “Camps” as a core event type, stating camps help children develop interests and put into practice skills learned throughout the year. European Youth Portal profile says scouts regularly have camps and nature events. This entry is a programme/network point, not a single fixed campsite.

category: 童軍中心 / 人道支援點 (Scout Centre / Humanitarian Support Point)
name: Kyiv Scout Centre humanitarian support point
nameEn: Kyiv Scout Centre / Humanitarian Support Point
description: WOSM emergency response report says Scout centres in Kyiv and Odesa have been used to collect and distribute clothes, shoes, sleeping bags, mats, food and other supplies during the humanitarian response. Specific safe/public address may vary; this entry uses Kyiv as official city representative point.

category: 童軍中心 / 人道支援點 (Scout Centre / Humanitarian Support Point)
name: Odesa Scout Centre humanitarian support point
nameEn: Odesa Scout Centre / Humanitarian Support Point
description: WOSM emergency response report notes that Odesa Scouts used scout centres for relief collection/distribution and also organised online activities for children during the emergency. This entry uses Odesa city as representative point.

category: 地方童軍區代表點 (Local Scout Area)
name: Kyiv Scouts / NOSU local area
description: Kyiv is NOSU’s main national contact city and an important local scout area. NOSU official website and EU profile list Kyiv addresses; WOSM reports also reference Kyiv scout centre support activities.

category: 地方童軍區代表點 (Local Scout Area)
name: Odesa Scouts / NOSU local area
description: WOSM emergency response and Peace Platform reporting mention scouts in Odesa and summer scout camp activity in Odesa Region. This is a representative local area point.

category: 地方童軍區代表點 (Local Scout Area)
name: Lviv Scouts / NOSU local area
description: WOSM Peace Platform report lists “School of a Warrior” in Lviv Region among NOSU-supported activities. This entry records Lviv as a representative western Ukraine scout area.

category: 地方童軍區代表點 (Local Scout Area)
name: Mykolaiv Scouts / NOSU local area
description: WOSM Peace Platform report lists a Festival of Scout Creativity in Mykolaiv as part of NOSU programmes. This entry records Mykolaiv as a representative local scout area.

category: 地方童軍區代表點 (Local Scout Area)
name: Cherkasy Region Scouts / NOSU local area
nameEn: Cherkasy Region Scouts / NOSU local area
address: Cherkasy Region, Ukraine; contact via NOSU
description: WOSM Peace Platform report lists the Ukrainian Scout Forum in Cherkasy Region among activities supported by NOSU. This entry uses Cherkasy Region as representative point.

category: 地方童軍區代表點 (Local Scout Area)
name: Ivano-Frankivsk Region Scouts / NOSU local area
nameEn: Ivano-Frankivsk Region Scouts / NOSU local area
address: Ivano-Frankivsk Region, Ukraine; contact via NOSU
description: WOSM Peace Platform report mentions Ivano-Frankivsk Region activity as part of NOSU’s joint national programmes. This entry is a representative local area point.

category: 地方童軍區代表點 (Local Scout Area)
name: Zaporizhzhia Scouts / NOSU local area
description: WOSM Peace Platform report lists Gathering “Gilea” in Zaporizhzhia among NOSU activities; this entry records Zaporizhzhia as representative scout area.

category: 地方童軍區代表點 (Local Scout Area)
name: Kharkiv Scouts / NOSU local area
description: NOSU official website notes 35+ groups in Ukraine; this entry records Kharkiv as a representative eastern Ukraine scout area within the nationwide network.

category: 地方童軍區代表點 (Local Scout Area)
name: Dnipro Scouts / NOSU local area
description: NOSU official website notes 35+ groups in Ukraine; this entry records Dnipro as a representative central/eastern Ukraine scout area within the nationwide network.
